content_sections.heading: About DMHO Kamareddy
content_sections.text: The Office of the District Medical & Health Officer (DM & HO), Kamareddy is a district office of the Government of Telangana. The posts in this notification fall under various programmes of the National Health Mission under the control of the DM & HO, Kamareddy, and recruitment is done by the District Selection Committee on behalf of the District Health Society. Appointees work under the overall administrative control of CH&FW and MD, NHM, Hyderabad.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 60 vacancies across 15 programme units, all in Kamareddy district and all on contract. The Staff Nurse rows together make 28 posts. The notice gives the roster point from which filling continues for some posts. Category-wise vacancy numbers are not printed. MLHP/CHO/MO Palle Dhawakana: the roster at Sl.No.59 (OC(W)) has been completed; the process continues with roster point No.60 (SEBC-B). Pharmacist: the roster at Sl.No.13 (Open) has been completed; the process continues with roster point No.14 (SEBC-C). Staff Nurse (Child Health and Maternal Health units, Sl. No. 7 to 11): the roster at Sl.No.79 (BC-A) has been completed; the process continues with roster point No.80 (Open). Staff Nurse (National Programme for Palliative Care): the roster shall be followed afresh. As per the Presidential Orders and G.O.Ms.No 124 GAD (SPF-MC) Dept., Dt 30.08.2018, the reserved and unreserved ratio for each unit of appointment applies.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice says the qualifications for the vacant posts are as per Government Guidelines shown in its post table. Each post's qualification is given below as printed. SSC/Inter. 18 months MPHW(F) Training Certificate recognized by TS Nursing and Midwives Council, OR two years Intermediate Vocational MPHW(F) Course and completed one year clinical training in a selected Government hospital in which these students have been permitted to undergo clinical training, OR completed one year Apprenticeship Training in identified hospitals and awarded the "Apprenticeship Completion Certificate" by the Board of Apprenticeship Training GoI, Southern Region, Chennai. Physical fitness for camp life. MBA/PG Diploma in management/health administration from a recognized institute/university. At least 1 year of work experience. Preference will be given to those who have worked in the field of Development/Health at District/State level. Basic knowledge of Computers. Medical Officer – MBBS: MBBS; registered with TS Medical council. Medical Officer – Ayerveda: BAMS; registered with Board of Indian Medicine. Staff Nurse (with B.Sc (Nursing) who have graduated from academic year 2020 onwards): B.Sc (Nursing); registered with Nursing council for TS. Staff Nurse (with B.Sc (Nursing) who have graduated before the academic year 2020): B.Sc (Nursing); registered with Nursing Council for TS; should have completed six months bridge programme in Community Health (CPCH). Staff Nurse (GNM): GNM; registered with Nursing Council for TS; should have completed six months bridge programme in Community Health (CPCH). The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 44 years, in terms of Rule 12(1)(a)(v) of the Telangana State and Subordinate Service Rules, 1996, reckoned as on 01.07.2026. For MLHP posts too, the notice says this age rule applies. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The notice prints the MLHP/CHO/MO Palle Dhawakana pay as "40000/29900" in a single cell; it does not state which of the eligible qualifications draws which amount. The mode of appointment is on Outsourcing basis or Contract basis for a period of 1 year or till the actual need ceases, whichever is earlier. Candidates selected under outsourcing mode shall be appointed through an Outsourcing Agency. The posts notified are not permanent/regular Government posts and are purely temporary. The termination notice shall be 30 days from either side. Performance will be evaluated from time to time and considered for extension/termination of service, in case of future requirement. The employment is subject to disciplinary/codal rules, and in case of any deviation employment is liable for termination. Selected candidates shall maintain the Headquarters; the positions are not transferable; selected candidates may have to perform tours.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Recruitment is done by the District Selection Committee on behalf of the concerned District Health Society. MLHP posts and all other posts are selected by different methods. The guidelines issued by CHFW T.G Hyderabad, Lr.Rc.No.96/NUHM/HWC/2017, Dated: 06.09.2022 are followed. Selection is based on the combined percentage of marks obtained in all years of MBBS/BAMS/B.Sc. (Nursing)/GNM (for 100 marks). Selection is on merit basis; merit lists are prepared separately for each category of post. Total marks are 100: 90 marks based on the marks obtained in the qualifying examination and 10 marks for age. Age weightage is counted from 18 years of age: 0.5 mark for each completed year, with a maximum of 10 marks, age reckoned as on 01-07-2026. Examples from the notice: 20 years gets 1.0 mark, 30 years gets 6.0 marks, 38 years gets 10.0 marks. The merit list will be displayed on the official website of the concerned District Collector for transparency and for calling objections. The selection list will be prepared from the finalized merit list following the Rule of Reservation (RoR), Presidential Orders and SC&ST Reservation rules. District Collector & Magistrate – Chairman District Medical & Health Officer – Member-Convener Deputy Director, Social Welfare – Member Superintendent, District Hqrs. (TVVP) Any other Government Officer may be included Reservation for Community, Disability and Ex-Service Men/Women is observed as ordered by the Government of Telangana from time to time. 33 1/3% reservation for women applies as per G.O.Ms.No.3, Dept. for Women, Children, Disabled & Sr. Citizens (Prog.I) dated 10.02.2024 and G.O.Ms.No.35, Genl.Admn. (Ser.D) Dept., dated 13.02.2024. Reservation for local candidates applies as per the Presidential Order and SC-ST reservation rules; the districts continue the existing roster. Vacancies for posts mentioned in G.O.68 falling in Scheduled Areas should be filled exclusively with Local Scheduled Tribes.

Enclose self-attested copies of the certificates listed below, with the Acknowledgement Card. Submit the filled form in person to the District Medical & Health Officer, Kamareddy. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are in DMHO Kamareddy Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 60 vacancies: 28 Staff Nurse, 25 MLHP/CHO/MO Palle Dhawakana, 3 Pharmacist and one each of 2nd ANM, Dental Technician, District Programme Coordinator and Physiotherapist.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for DMHO Kamareddy Staff Nurse posts?
faq.answer: Staff Nurse posts need B.Sc (Nursing) or GNM with registration with TS Nursing Council; the two National Programme for Palliative Care posts need M.Sc (Nursing) with two years experience and registration with TS nursing council.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for DMHO Kamareddy Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 44 years as on 01.07.2026, with 5 years relaxation for SCs/STs/BCs and EWS and 10 years for Physically Handicapped persons.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of DMHO Kamareddy posts?
faq.answer: Monthly remuneration is Rs. 27300 for 2nd ANMs and Pharmacist, Rs. 22650 for Dental Technician, Rs. 26410 for District Programme Coordinator, 40000/29900 for MLHP/CHO/MO Palle Dhawakana, Rs. 33650 for Physiotherapist and Rs. 29900 for Staff Nurse.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.500/- for all candidates, paid by DD/BC in favour of District Medical and Health Officer, Kamareddy from any nationalized bank.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for DMHO Kamareddy Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Download the form from the official website of the district and submit it in person, with self-attested certificates and the Rs.500/- DD/BC, to the District Medical & Health Officer, Kamareddy.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected for non-MLHP posts?
faq.answer: Selection is on merit out of 100 marks: 90 marks for qualifying examination marks and up to 10 marks for age, at 0.5 mark per completed year from 18 years as on 01-07-2026.

faq.question: Q8. How are MLHP candidates selected?
faq.answer: MLHP selection is based on the combined percentage of marks obtained in all years of MBBS/BAMS/B.Sc. (Nursing)/GNM, for 100 marks.

faq.question: Q9. Are these permanent government jobs?
faq.answer: No. The posts are not permanent/regular Government posts and are purely temporary, on outsourcing or contract basis for 1 year or till the actual need ceases, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. Who gets the ex-servicemen age relaxation?
faq.answer: Ex-servicemen get 3 years plus length of service in armed forces, applicable only for the posts of Medical Officer.
